on_state_breakpoint.rule: max Vds where golden input[0] >= 0.95*vgs_on (from YAML), clamped to vbus so no breakpoint exceeds the bus

cap_error.method: finite-difference dQ/dV of the emitted (V,Q) pairs vs measured C(v) on the common measured grid; relative to local C, denominator clipped at 0.1% of peak C

algorithm.breakpoint_formula: greedy pwl_charge_segments farthest-point rule on anchored Q(V); no point cap; CDS/CDG forced DPT on-state breakpoint; no breakpoint above vbus

hybrid_channel.knee_selection: deterministic greedy: scan supplied Vds grid in ascending order, add knee minimising global RMSE, tie -> lowest Vds
hybrid_channel.knee_scope: shared across the Vgs family (one per-row list in vds_knees)

source_rows.target: Curve-1 breakpoints_id (same spec as Tier-2 channel)

hybrid_channel.known_limitation: measured 2-pulse DPT Vds RMSE regressed vs closed Tier-2: TI 11.20% vs 6.06%, CPM2 7.10% vs 2.79% (local://hybrid_channel_feasibility.md, 2026-11-20). Static fidelity only; transient superiority not demonstrated.

energy_decomposition.rule: Measured split of the extract_dpt_metrics turn-off window [gate 0.9*plateau falling, drain 0.9*vbus rising + 100 ns]: transition = [gate fall, Vds 10 %], rise = [Vds 10 %, 90 %], tail = [Vds 90 %, +100 ns]. e_off_uj / the *_uj parts integrate the ABSOLUTE current magnitude and are kept only to expose the rectification; the scored energy is e_off_signed_uj / the *_signed_uj parts, which is what extract_dpt_metrics uses when the run carries the signed device current. rectified_tail_uj = tail - signed tail is zero-mean post-turn-off ringing converted into apparent loss by abs(), not device dissipation. Diagnostic only: no correction element is emitted.

energy_current_definition.rule: switching energy integrates the signed device current I(Lload)-I(Dclamp); timing/G3 remain on its absolute magnitude

energy.correction: measurement correction: turn-on/turn-off energy integrates the signed device current I(Lload)-I(Dclamp); abs() rectified post-turn-off ringing into apparent loss. Bars unchanged.

channel_candidates.selection_rule: FIDELITY-FIRST ONLY: hybrid is selected ONLY IF, for both charge modes, it strictly improves Vds RMSE, Id RMSE and abs(rel err) of tr/tf/e_on/e_off over the corresponding Tier-2-channel candidate on the same forced-2ns DPT guard. Else Tier-2 channel.
